title: Availability
tagline: When guests can book, on one page
intro: Availability is the page where a restaurant manager sets when guests can book a table.

steps.say: The page lists your rules in five rows, from regular hours to booking rules.
steps.do: const { tsImport } = await import('tsx/esm/api'); globalThis.tour = await tsImport('../apps/hospitality/e2e/launch-demo/availability-tour.ts', import.meta.url); await globalThis.tour.prepareAvailabilityTour(page); await page.getByRole('heading', { level: 2, name: 'Your rules' }).waitFor();

steps.say: Type any date to see the hours guests can book and which rule decided them.
steps.do: const field = page.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Check a date' }); await field.click(); await field.pressSequentially(globalThis.tour.typedChristmasEve(), { delay: 120 }); await field.press('Enter'); await page.getByTestId('hub-date-answer').waitFor();

steps.say: Regular hours are your normal week, and they apply whenever nothing else does.
steps.do: await page.getByTestId('hub-row-1').getByRole('link', { name: 'Edit Regular hours' }).click(); await page.getByRole('radio', { name: 'Schedules' }).waitFor();

steps.say: Special dates and holidays change single days, like shorter hours on Christmas Eve.
steps.do: await page.goBack(); await page.getByTestId('hub-row-3').getByRole('link', { name: 'Edit Special dates and holidays' }).click(); await page.getByRole('radio', { name: 'Special dates' }).waitFor();

steps.say: Closures and pauses stop bookings for a day, or pause online booking for tonight.
steps.do: await page.goBack(); await page.getByTestId('hub-row-4').getByRole('link', { name: 'View Closures and pauses' }).click(); const pause = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Pause online booking' }); await pause.waitFor(); await page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Close/ }).first().hover(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); await pause.hover();

outro: You can answer what any date looks like in one glance.
